fallbackIssue.relayMustBeEnabled: Deliverability fallback relay must be enabled in this route
fallbackIssue.requiresOwnMta: Deliverability fallback requires an enabled owned-MTA route

multiRelay.title: More than one relay is configured
multiRelay.remedy: Keep exactly one relay enabled while you migrate. Until then the share stays where it is: with two reference arms there is no single comparison to judge your own server against, so no cell can be cleared to grow.

undescribed.title: The relay’s signing identity isn’t verified yet
undescribed.remedy: Verify this sending domain with the relay (or turn the relay off to run on your own server alone). The share holds until the two arms can be compared.

awaitingPrimary.label: Waiting on this domain
awaitingPrimary.summary: Verify the primary owned-MTA domain first; {relay} relay provisioning starts afterward.

provisioning.label: Provisioning
provisioning.summary: Registration at {relay} is queued. Refresh shortly to see the DNS plan.

reChecking.label: Re-checking
reChecking.summary: This domain verified, but the confirmation is older than Owlat will rely on. Sending through {relay} holds until the next check confirms it — nothing for you to do.

verified.label: Verified
verified.summary: {relay} can sign and send as this domain. Nothing to publish.

pending.label: Waiting on DNS
pending.summary: Publish the records below. {relay} re-checks on its own schedule and this page follows.

unverified.label: Not published yet
unverified.summary: {relay} has no record of this domain's DNS yet. Publish the records below to start.

failed.label: Cannot check
failed.summary: {relay} rejected the credential, so this domain cannot be confirmed. Your published DNS is untouched — fix the credential and the check resumes.

replyCollision.sendHoldReason: held while {name} is editing — takes over automatically if they leave
replyCollision.collisionToast: {name} just sent a reply — review the thread

applying.label: Applying your configuration
applying.detail: Writing your settings to the server.

waiting.label: Waiting for the app to come back
waiting.detail: Almost there — reconnecting as soon as it’s online.

timeout.label: Taking longer than usual
timeout.detail: Still waiting for the app to come back.
